youtube.script: What is the real AI workflow upgrade this week? It is not just faster generation — it is better control points. OpenAI says ChatGPT Work can move across web, mobile and desktop. Canva says its new AI stack adds research, scheduling and brand controls. Notion lets you assign external agents from a shared board. The practical lesson: let AI draft from your source files, but keep a human review step before anything goes out the door. If the workflow has no checkpoint, it is not ready.
